item.title: Salesforce Agentic Enterprise Index：Agent 部署同比增长 2 倍多
item.summary: An analysis of Agentforce usage among businesses consistently leveraging agents from February 2025 to April 2026 shows how different industries deploy AI agents while building trust and recognizing ROI. Salesforce has released its 2026 Agentic Enterprise Index, which analyzes aggregated AI usage data from the Agentforc
